name: mVISE AG I
summary: mVISE AG provides mobile business solutions, concentrating its expertise on mobile and cloud computing technologies. The company further specializes in developing robust information technology infrastructures, ensuring their security, and managing the integration and analysis of data. Established on September 19, 2000, by founders Thomas Wolf, Claus Darnstaedt, and Joao Gonzaga, its main office is located in Duesseldorf, Germany.
